decision: Echo Brain is the tool-agnostic connection and processing core. Meeting sources, decision processors, communication channels, and later product surfaces are adapters around canonical contracts; no vendor defines a core model.
architectural_invariants: src/core never imports src/adapters or vendor implementations
all adapter instances share identity, configuration, health, and error contracts
meeting sources, decision processors, and communication channels use separate typed capabilities
the core persists provenance, approval, idempotency, and delivery receipts
adapter-specific settings are opaque to the core and validated by the owning adapter
new adapters pass the shared conformance suite before runtime composition

compatibility.granola: retained as the first meeting-source implementation behind an explicit adapter namespace
compatibility.installed_run: remains fail-closed until configured adapter instances and concrete runtime components are available
